suggestions.title: Optimize Third-Party Script Loading
suggestions.description: The auth0-spa-js third-party script causes render-blocking and delays in reaching LCP. It introduces unnecessary processing pre-LCP due to significant unused code.
suggestions.implementation: Self-host auth0-spa-js library to reduce DNS lookup times. Consider code splitting to load only critical code pre-LCP, and defer non-essential functionalities. Evaluate possibility of making this resource non-blocking.

suggestions.title: Reduce and Normalize Image Sizes
suggestions.description: Multiple large images are loaded with dimensions exceeding device-specific requirements, impacting load times significantly.
suggestions.implementation: Use srcset attribute with appropriately sized images for different viewports to minimize excessive image loading.

suggestions.title: Restructure CSS and JS Loading Strategies
suggestions.description: There is potential to defer non-critical styling and scripts using lazy-styles.css and loadDelayed.
suggestions.implementation: Ensure that lazy-styles.css contains only non-critical CSS. Utilize ‘loadEager’ to optimize the sequence of styling and functional scripts loaded in the critical path.
